allOf.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

justify.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together. Values: `start` packs children at the top; `center` centers children vertically; `end` packs children at the bottom; `spaceBetween` distributes extra space between children and pushes the first and last child to the edges; `spaceAround` places equal space around each child; `spaceEvenly` places equal space between children and at both edges.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property. Values: `start` aligns children to the left/start edge; `center` centers children horizontally; `end` aligns children to the right/end edge.
